chars.ABDELMOULA: ABDELMOULA: a short young Moroccan man with a big round head, short black hair, clean-shaven, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie and dark blue jeans
chars.REDA: REDA: a very tall slim Moroccan young man with curly black hair, wearing a red tracksuit jacket with white side stripes and black trousers
chars.YOUSSEF: YOUSSEF: a stocky Moroccan young man with a trimmed black beard, wearing a grey suit blazer over a black t-shirt

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Night, a dim smoky bar in Rabat, Morocco. REDA and YOUSSEF lean across a small table toward ABDELMOULA, whispering urgently and pushing him, greedy eyes; ABDELMOULA leans back, tense and uneasy. Glasses on the table, warm low light.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Night in a small modest bedroom in a Moroccan popular neighbourhood house. ABDELMOULA lies awake on his bed staring at the ceiling, eyes wide, a sudden dangerous idea lighting up his face; moonlight through the window.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Late night, ABDELMOULA sits at a cluttered desk in his room, laptop glowing and a large colour printer beside him, typing intensely with a nervous focused face, sheets of blank paper stacked, curtains closed.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: ABDELMOULA at his desk holding a sheet of paper up to the lamp light, frowning in frustration, crumpled rejected sheets all over the floor and desk, printer next to him.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Night, the printer spits out sheet after sheet of Moroccan-looking banknotes; huge piles of cash cover the desk and floor; ABDELMOULA stands frozen in shock, sweat on his forehead, hands on his head.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: In ABDELMOULA's small room, ABDELMOULA throws a big pile of cash onto the bed while REDA and YOUSSEF step in through the door, stopping in their tracks.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Close view: REDA and YOUSSEF stunned, mouths open, holding bundles of banknotes in disbelief, ABDELMOULA beside them watching nervously; piles of money around them.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Night, the three young men sit on the floor around a mountain of cash in a dark room lit by a single lamp, curtains shut, faces worried and paranoid, YOUSSEF glancing at the window, REDA biting his nails.
